_comment: THE INVRISIL RETURN PROOF, pallass_round_trip's twin. `invrisil_anchor_stone` shipped a bare (wrapper-less) portal_menu_when that was vacuously true; wrapping it at door_awakened -- the authored intent -- would have STRANDED the cohort that buys Eloise's 18g stone at door_mounted without ever awakening the Door, since the boulevard/alleys/parlor cluster's only way home IS this stone. Gate is door_mounted, and this canonical is the walking proof. Rides the shipped spine_reach_start (no new fixture), the same one pallass_round_trip uses. Departs Liscor at street_anchor_stone, lands on the portals `invrisil` row's own arrival cell (4,8), walks the boulevard end to end (row 8, detouring the (14,8) blocker), crosses into mercantile_alleys and back through the real door pair, returns to the anchor and rides the picker home to the inn's authored (13,6). Exact options pins at both ends. The alleys leg stays at x<=5 on row 7, four cells clear of alley_footpads_a's (9,9) trigger_radius 2; the boulevard's two night encounters sit on row 15 behind an encounter_when:{phase:[night]} this daytime run never meets. Zero combat; seed inert.

steps._comment: Down to 'Continue'; confirm loads the spine_reach_start manual slot.
== DEPART: street_anchor_stone (30,10) from the liscor_street row's own arrival cell (29,10). Bump right to face it (its cell is blocked, so facing sets without moving). ==

payload_contains.text: The light turns pale and cool, and the noise of a much bigger city rushes in to fill the silence. Invrisil, same as the letter promised.

steps._comment: == WALK THE BOULEVARD: east along row 8 to the alley door (26,8), stepping up to row 7 around the (14,8) blocker and back down. ==

== THE ALLEYS, briefly: four cells east along row 7 and back. Stays outside alley_footpads_a's (9,9) trigger_radius 2 at every step -- the bent-route sneak work is invrisil_walkthrough's subject, not this one's. Return through the same door pair. ==

== THE WAY HOME: retrace west to the anchor's approach (4,8) -- the row's own arrival cell -- and bump west into the stone's blocked cell (3,8) to face it. The picker opens on door_mounted (NOT door_awakened: this fixture has both, but the gate is the one every arrival implies), and the menu excludes Invrisil itself. ==

payload_contains.text: Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.

steps._comment: Scope guard: the whole route is travel only.
